summary: A button with two parts: a main clickable action, and an attached arrow that opens a small menu of related options.
description: Two separately-implemented split-button-shaped patterns exist at once, not one. Classic: a customized-built-in element registered as plain <button> (customElements.define("button", MozButton), toolkit/content/widgets/button.js), where type="menu" renders a .button-menu-dropmarker fragment alongside icon+label (MozButton.menuFragment) with a <menupopup> child, used in historySidebar.xhtml, customizeMode.inc.xhtml, and others. Modern: <moz-button type="split">, a mode of moz-button already documented under the "button" component (its own type variant list includes "split"). toolkit/content/widgets/toolbarbutton.js has no menu-button/split rendering branch (only plain icon+label and a badged icon+label, no dropmarker), so it is not the split-button implementation; <button> (this entry) is.

implementation.file: toolkit/content/widgets/button.js, class MozButton (classic); toolkit/content/widgets/moz-button/moz-button.mjs, type="split" (modern, see the "button" component)

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: On classic <button>: "menu" renders the real dropmarker split-button fragment (MozButton.menuFragment). Other classic values (checkbox, radio) are unrelated modes of the same MozButtonBase class, not split-button variants.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Classic <button>'s visible text; inherited onto .button-text along with accesskey and crop (static inheritedAttributes).

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: Path to the icon image; inherited onto .button-icon's src (inheritedAttributes: "src=image").

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Classic <button>'s disabled state, reflected via MozButtonBase and inherited onto the dropmarker too.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflects/controls the associated <menupopup>'s open state via hasMenu()/openMenu().

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Getter: this.querySelector(".button-icon"), the classic <button>'s icon image element.

cssProperties.name: --button-gap-split
cssProperties.description: Gap between the main action and the chevron, on the modern <moz-button type="split">.

cssProperties.name: --button-border-width-split
cssProperties.description: Border width of the inner divider between the main action and the chevron, on the modern <moz-button type="split">.

cssProperties.name: --button-split-separator-background-color
cssProperties.description: Color of the divider line between the main action and the chevron, on the modern <moz-button type="split">.

usage:
<button type="menu" label="View">
  <menupopup>...</menupopup>
</button>
<!-- classic dropmarker split button (button.js, class MozButton). -->
<!-- for the modern equivalent, see <moz-button type="split"> under the "button" component -->
